subject: CloudDelta — access implementation ops lane & technical transfer
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <pri@clouddelta.com>
Cc: Anil Shah <anil.shah@clouddelta.com>
Date: 2026-11-22 09:22 -0800
Subject: CloudDelta — access implementation ops lane & technical transfer

Hi team,

Per our renewal conversation, CloudDelta is greenlit to start production onboarding next week. I'm handing off the implementation coordination to Ben (SE) and Jonas (Delivery). Below is a concise ops lane for the access controls work we need to complete before cutover.

High-level objective:
- Deliver SSO (SAML v2) + SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist, and service-account policy for CloudDelta's prod environment by 2026-12-03.

Immediate asks (first 3 business days):
- Customer: confirm SCIM attribute mapping (see attached CSV) and provide final IP ranges for allowlist.
- Redwood SE: validate SAML metadata exchange and confirm ACS/Entity ID URLs.
- Delivery: schedule a 60-min technical runbook session with customer's infra and security teams.

Attachments: CD-SSO-SCIM-attribute-mapping.csv (CSV), clouddelta-ip-allowlist-20261121.txt (TXT), rdw-implementation-lane-v1.pdf (PDF)

Proposed schedule (draft):
1) 11/23 - mapping + IP ranges confirmed (customer)
2) 11/24 - technical runbook (60m) w/ SE + customer infra
3) 11/25-11/30 - staged SCIM sync and allowlist testing
4) 12/01 - final smoke test and sign-off

Ben/Jonas: please take this forward and update the runbook in the Drive link below. Priya/Anil: let me know if those dates work and who from your team will join the runbook session.

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Priya Rao <pri@clouddelta.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anil Shah <anil.shah@clouddelta.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22 12:08 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudDelta — access implementation ops lane & technical transfer

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — this looks good. Quick clarifications from our side before the runbook session:
- SCIM mapping: we reviewed the CSV and have two changes: prefer 'employeeNumber' as the unique id and include 'department' as a required attribute. I'll attach our current Okta mapping export by EOD.
- IP ranges: attaching the network ranges used by our prod NAT gateways (see clouddelta-ip-allowlist-20261121.txt).
- Service accounts: we plan to create a single service principal with constrained scopes; security@clouddelta.com will manage keys.

11/24 for the technical session works. Attendees from CloudDelta: myself (Priya, IT Ops), Anil Shah (sec), and Ravi Kumar (platform eng — ravi@clouddelta.com).

One ask: can the SE confirm we have the right SAML assertion attributes for group membership? Our app relies on group claims for role mapping.

Thanks,
Priya

---
Priya Rao
Head of IT Operations
CloudDelta, Inc.
pri@clouddelta.com | +1 (650) 555-9876
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <pri@clouddelta.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Anil Shah <anil.shah@clouddelta.com>
Date: 2026-11-23 08:15 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudDelta — access implementation ops lane & technical transfer

Thanks Priya — good details. Short responses and plan from the SE side: 

- SCIM: employeeNumber as the unique identifier is fine; we'll add department to the required attributes. We'll update the attached CSV and push a 'v2' into the shared Drive by 11/23 17:00 PST.
- SAML group claims: Redwood supports both 'groups' and custom claim names. Can you confirm how Okta emits group membership (group names vs. group IDs)? If it's names, we'll map them directly; if IDs, we'll need a lookup table.
- IP allowlist: the ranges you sent look good. We'll add them to a staging rule for the tenant and open a temporary access window for your verification team.
- Service account: recommended pattern — single scoped service account for provisioning operations + short-lived keys (rotate weekly). We'll provide the IAM policy template in the runbook.

Technical session agenda (11/24, 10:00 - 11:00 PST):
1) SAML metadata exchange and assertion preview (15m)
2) SCIM attribute mapping and test provisioning (20m)
3) IP allowlist staging and validation plan (10m)
4) Service account policy & rollout steps (10m)
5) Q/A and next steps (5m)

Join link and updated runbook here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleLink
Attachments referenced: rdw-implementation-lane-v1.pdf (updated runbook), CD-SSO-SCIM-attribute-mapping.csv (will be updated to v2)

I'll prepare a sample SAML assertion we can use during the session. See you all Thursday.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Re: CloudDelta — access implementation ops lane & technical transfer

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Priya: I've added Ravi to the calendar invite. Ben/Jonas: please lead the session and add any pre-reads to the Drive before 09:00 PST tomorrow so the CloudDelta team can review.

Checkpoints after the runbook session:
- Confirm SCIM test user provisioning (pass/fail)
- Verify SAML assertions contain expected group claims for at least two roles
- Confirm staging allowlist behavior and rollback plan

I'll follow up with the rollout cadence and weekly status updates in the Drive.

Thanks,
Marissa
